name: Plant Requirements Agent
description: Nuclear system design, component requirements generation, and model audit agent. Supports loop design with thermodynamic/hydraulic sizing, requirements filtering from a ~1500-requirement baseline across 6 component types, and engineering model auditability.

skills.name: Design Nuclear Loop
skills.description: One-shot nuclear system loop design from a natural language query. Performs deterministic thermodynamic and hydraulic sizing and returns an Alchemy-format topology graph with sized component properties.

query.description: Natural language design request, e.g. '300 MWth PWR primary loop' or '500 MWth sodium-cooled fast reactor'

skills.name: Conversational Loop Design
skills.description: Stateless multi-turn loop design conversation. The client sends the full message history on every call so the agent can reconstruct state. Returns agent_reply and the completed Alchemy design when is_done is true.

initial_query.description: The initial design query that started the conversation

history.description: Full message history as [{role, content}] objects. Omit or leave empty for the first turn.

skills.name: Component Requirements (One-Shot)
skills.description: One-shot component requirements filtering. Provide a component type and its full profile (classification + sizing parameters) to receive all applicable requirements from the baseline.

component_type.description: Component type: pump, valve, condenser, steam_generator, pressurizer, or turbine

profile.description: Component profile dictionary with classification fields (code_class, safety_category, seismic_category, environment_profile) and sizing parameters

skills.name: Conversational Requirements
skills.description: Stateless multi-turn requirements conversation. The agent asks clarifying questions to collect the component profile, then returns the filtered requirements instance when all required information has been gathered.

initial_query.description: Initial requirements query, e.g. 'requirements for a PWR feedwater pump'

history.description: Full message history as [{role, content}] objects. Omit or leave empty for the first turn.

skills.name: Requirements from Design Node
skills.description: Generate requirements for a component that was produced by a loop design. Numeric parameters (flow rate, head, rated power, thermal duty, operating pressures) are pre-filled from the sized node properties; only classification fields are asked interactively.

node_name.description: Name of the design node from alchemy_db, e.g. 'Primary Sink', 'SG', 'Turbine', 'FWP'

node_props.description: Properties dictionary of the specific node (from alchemy_db parts[*].properties)

all_node_props.description: Optional: properties for all nodes, used for cross-node sizing context. Set to null if not available.

history.description: Full message history as [{role, content}] objects. Omit or leave empty for the first turn.

skills.name: Audit Engineering Models
skills.description: Ask free-text questions about the engineering models, thermodynamic correlations, fluid property sources, hydraulic assumptions, and references used in the agent. Use question='list' to see all available topics, or provide a topic_id to retrieve a specific topic directly.

question.description: Free-text question, e.g. 'How is energy conservation done?' or 'list' to see all available topics

topic_id.description: Optional: retrieve a specific topic by its ID (IDs are returned in matched_topics from previous audit calls)
